# CastCard

One actor: a 4:5 headshot, their name and the character they play; shown in a sideways-scrolling Cast row on show and movie pages.

`TVTracker.CastCard` · Media

## Use

```jsx

```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.CastCard" name="…"></x-import>
```

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `string` | Actor's name. |
| `role` | `string` | Character played. |
| `image` | `string` | Headshot URL (4:5). Without it, initials on bg-raised. |
